response.sql:
WITH event_attendance AS (
    SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
), total_attendance AS (
    SELECT SUM(attendance_count) AS total_count
    FROM event_attendance
)
SELECT ea.event_id,
       ea.attendance_count,
       CAST(ea.attendance_count AS REAL) / ta.total_count AS share_of_total_attendance
FROM event_attendance AS ea
CROSS JOIN total_attendance AS ta
WHERE ta.total_count > 0
ORDER BY share_of_total_attendance DESC, ea.event_id
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Only events with at least one attendance record are included; events with no attendance have a zero share and do not enter the top 10 when any attendance exists.
